overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the notice listing Town Manager candidate interviews adequately described the anticipated post-interview discussion and vote, though a more specific topic would have been helpful.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board discussed and voted on its Town Manager choice at a May 27 interview meeting without listing that topic on the notice.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the notice sufficiently described the anticipated discussion such that any member of the public interested in the Town Manager appointment process had sufficient information to decide whether to attend the meeting.
